newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index little changed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index little changed in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed little changed on Tuesday in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 603.84 from 604.33 on Monday.
Trade volume was 739,907 dinars against 633,646 dinars.
Coke bottler SFBT was down 3.35 dinars to 108.34 dinars. BDET bank eased 0.46 dinar to 14.82 dinars.
BIAT rose 1.8 dinar to 61.86 dinars. UIB bank was up 0.13 dinar to 11.79 dinars. ($1=0.98 dinar)
